note: Documented limitation: a bare 'Intern' suffix glued to an undelimited occupational phrase, with no delimiter/parenthetical, fails the same structural segment-exactness rule as every other value — uniform conservatism across all four values, not a special case for internship. A delimited or parenthesized form is recognized; see positive_title_only_internship.

note: Bare 'seasonal' describing produce, not this position's own arrangement; 'produce' is not an arrangement noun.

title: University Relations Specialist
description: Prior internship experience is required for this role.
note: Binding-correction counterexample: bare 'internship' describing a candidate requirement ('internship experience required'), not this posting's own type; 'experience' is not an arrangement noun, and 'role' appears too far away to combine.

title: Retail Sales Associate

title: Operations Assistant
description: This role is not seasonal.

title: Program Assistant
description: This is not an internship position.

title: (Full-Time] Software Engineer
note: An opening parenthesis paired with a closing bracket is not a valid structural marker; the mismatched delimiters fall through to the plain-segment tokens, which no longer exactly equal the bare phrase once 'Software Engineer' is included.

title: [Full-Time) Software Engineer
note: An opening bracket paired with a closing parenthesis is not a valid structural marker, symmetric to the previous case.

title: Software Engineer [Full-Time]
note: Positive control proving a properly paired bracket marker is still accepted, distinct from the two crossed-delimiter regressions above.

title: Software Engineer — Full-Time Contract
note: Binding-correction cross-axis control: 'Contract' is contract_type vocabulary, cross-axis masked as inert, leaving 'Full-Time' as an exact structural segment match. No conflict, because 'contract' is not part of this parser's vocabulary at all.

title: Support Specialist — Part-Time Temporary
note: Same cross-axis masking mechanism as the Full-Time Contract case, with 'Temporary' as the masked inert companion.

title: Operations Lead
description: This is a full-time contract position based in our downtown office.
note: Cross-axis masking removes 'contract' from the compacted sentence before phrase search, so 'full-time' and 'position' become contiguous and match.

title: Seasonal, Full-Time
note: Binding decision #5, exact required regression: two comma-delimited segments each independently match a distinct value (seasonal, full_time); two distinct labels is a conflict, even though both may be true in reality — jobs.employment_type is a single scalar column, documented as a limitation of that column, not of this parser.

title: Part-Time Internship
note: Binding decision #5, exact required regression: one undelimited 3-token segment does not exactly equal either the 2-token full/part-time phrase or the 1-token internship phrase, so no structural title signal is produced at all. Still unavailable, via 'no exact match' rather than a detected conflict — an intentional, documented asymmetry with the comma-delimited case above, not a special case for internship (internship is never masked or treated as inert here).

title: Data Coordinator
description: This is not a full-time position or part-time role.
note: Both 'full-time position' and 'part-time role' are qualified phrases; negation directly suppresses the nearer one and propagates across the coordinated 'or' (exactly one token between the spans) to suppress the farther one too, mirroring remote.py's proven or/nor coordination proof case.

title: Operations Associate
description: This position is not full-time or part-time.
note: Binding-correction exact required regression: neither bare candidate is qualified in this word order ('position' precedes rather than follows them), so both already contribute nothing regardless of negation; negation and or/nor coordination are still exercised but do not change the outcome. Proves 'not full-time or part-time' cannot leak part_time.

title: Client Relations Specialist
description: This is not, under any circumstances, a full-time position.
note: 'full-time position' is qualified, but the negator is 5 tokens away, outside the 3-token window; the unresolved-negation rule discards the whole sentence's candidates rather than leaving it as a confident positive.

title: Payroll Assistant
description: Please submit your W2 reporting information by January 31st.
note: Binding-correction counterexample: 'W2' is contract_type/tax-classification vocabulary, entirely absent from this parser's catalog; masked as an inert cross-axis token and contributes zero evidence.

title: Finance Clerk
description: Attach a completed 1099 tax form to your application.
note: Binding-correction counterexample: '1099' is contract_type/tax-classification vocabulary, masked as an inert cross-axis token.

title: Contract-to-Hire Software Engineer
note: 'Contract-to-hire' is purely contract_type vocabulary and carries no employment_type schedule information at all; masked as an inert cross-axis phrase, leaving only occupational words that do not match any catalog phrase.

title: Per Diem Nurse
note: Binding decision #4: 'per diem' is unsupported in v1 and resolves to no evidence — masked as an inert cross-axis phrase, not silently assigned to either axis.

title: Software Engineering — Internship
description: This internship position runs for 10 weeks during the summer.
note: Title and description independently agree on internship; agreement escalates provenance to parsed_description, matching remote.py's precedence rule.

title: Analyst (Full-Time)
description: This is a part-time position requiring 20 hours weekly.
note: Cross-field disagreement (title says full_time, description says part_time) always yields unavailable rather than guessing which field to trust.

title: Software Engineer (Ｉｎｔｅｒｎｓｈｉｐ)
note: Full-width Latin 'Internship' NFKC-normalizes to ASCII before matching, same as remote.py's analogous unicode-robustness case.

title: Operations Analyst
description: We value your full commitment. Time management skills are essential for this role.
note: 'full' ends the first sentence and 'time' begins the second; sentence-splitting happens before tokenization and phrase search, so they can never combine into the full_time bare phrase across the period.

title: Program Coordinator
description: This is neither a full-time position nor anything else notable.
note: Fresh-context adversarial finding: 'neither' was missing from the negation cue list in the initial draft, which let a genuinely-negated qualified candidate ('full-time position') survive as a false positive. Added 'neither' as a negation cue to close this gap; this regression pins the fix.

title: Warehouse Lead
description: We are hiring for a temp full-time role during the holiday rush.
note: 'temp' (the common abbreviation of the approved-inert 'temporary') is cross-axis masked, same as 'contract'/'temporary' themselves.

title: Support Specialist — Temp-to-Perm Full-Time
note: 'temp-to-perm' (the same transitional-arrangement concept as the approved-inert 'contract_to_hire') is cross-axis masked as a 3-token phrase, leaving 'Full-Time' as an exact structural segment match.

title: University Relations Coordinator
description: This is a paid internship, not a full-time position.
note: KNOWN, DOCUMENTED LIMITATION (see module docstring): pins the current actual behavior, not the ideal one. Bare 'internship' (distance 1, before 'not') wins the nearest-candidate slot over qualified 'full-time position' (distance 2, after 'not', in a separate clause), so the genuinely-negated qualified candidate incorrectly survives. A 'qualified always wins' tie-break was considered and rejected because it breaks the symmetric, already-correct 'Not internship, full-time position available.' pattern. Flagged for Codex/user review rather than silently left undiscovered.
